title: Paloma Business Fee Annex: Free Payouts and Per-Payout Fees
content:
Each Paloma Business plan grants free payouts at the start of every monthly billing period (annual plans receive the grant every month), says whether unused free payouts carry into the next period, and prices payouts that are not free.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free payouts granted per monthly billing period | 0 | 10 | 40 | 150 | 500 | 1500 |
| Unused free payouts carry into the next period | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Payout fee (USD per local-rail payout that does not use a free payout) | 2.99 | 2.49 | 1.99 | 1.49 | 0.99 | 0.49 |
| SWIFT payout fee (USD per SWIFT payout) | 29.99 | 24.99 | 19.99 | 14.99 | 9.99 | 7.99 |
| API payout discount (USD taken off the payout fee for a payout submitted through the API) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.40 | 0.20 |

### Footnotes

1. SWIFT payouts never use the free allowance; every SWIFT payout is priced at the plan's SWIFT payout fee.
2. The payout fee is charged only on a local-rail payout that does not use a free payout.
3. The API payout discount is taken off the payout fee for a payout submitted through the API, and the result is never below 0.00 USD.
4. On no plan do unused free payouts carry into the next period.

### Hypothetical illustration

On Paloma Business Scale, a local-rail payout submitted through the API that does not use a free payout is priced at the payout fee of 0.99 USD less the API payout discount of 0.40 USD, that is 0.59 USD. A SWIFT payout on the same plan is priced at 9.99 USD whatever free payouts remain.
